purpose: Trace real ownership and consumers for remaining semantic-boundary candidates without fabricating consumers, duplicating semantic authorities, or reclassifying in downstream layers.

checks.name: ControllerExpressionFact is currently a declaration-only contract, not a discovered producer-consumer path
ExpressionDefinition is currently a declaration-only expression-plus-source contract
ValidationRuleDefinition is distinct from the active domain ValidationRuleNode pipeline
The active validation path uses explicit domain rule contracts rather than silently consuming ValidationRuleDefinition
SchemaRelationTarget is not consumed as the active schema relation authority
Schema relation authority is represented by SchemaRelationInterface and SchemaRelationIndexInterface
Canonical model semantic construction consumes schemaRelationIndexFrom rather than reconstructing SchemaRelationTarget
RouteConstraintFlow has no active producer/consumer while routeDataFlow owns active constraint facts
ApiResourceAction is a declaration-only alias and resource action plan remains the semantic output
Manifest wiring validates complete AST before building the canonical Laravel source model
DataFlowInterface separates producer and consumer authority contracts
IR consumes semantic dataflow authority while structural graph uses GraphEdgeRelation projection
CLI and SDK consume explicit operation identity instead of classifying HTTP methods/actions
No artificial references or new semantic bridge were added to silence declaration-only findings
Package build script remains unchanged as tsdown and declared TypeScript target remains 7.0.2

architecture.sourceToManifest: Laravel source -> CompleteSourceAst validation -> CompleteLaravelSourceModel -> manifest/dataflow seeds
architecture.validation: Laravel validation evidence -> current domain ValidationRuleNode/ValidationRuleParser path -> existing schema/IR target projection; ValidationRuleDefinition is not wired in this phase
architecture.schema: SchemaInterface -> schemaRelationIndexFrom -> SchemaRelationIndexInterface -> model semantic relation construction
architecture.dataflow: SemanticDataflowInput -> DataFlow authority/consumer interface -> IR projection; structural relations -> GraphEdgeRelation -> graph projection
architecture.downstream: Capability/identity projection -> CLI -> SDK -> React hooks; transport, validation, mapping and cache concerns remain target-runtime responsibilities

validationLimits: Static source-contract audit only; not a full build or runtime test.
Environment has TypeScript 5.8.3 globally and package.json declares 7.0.2; no local node_modules or tsdown executable is available.

Official TypeScript 7.0 announcement states TypeScript 7.0 does not ship a programmatic API; API-dependent audits should use the compatibility package/API version appropriate to their needs rather than assuming the 7.0 compiler exposes the TypeScript 5.x Compiler API.
